nodes.label: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
nodes.rationale: Publishes main.js and manifest.json as GitHub release assets on every tag push.

nodes.label: Ultimate Obsidian Sync Plugin
nodes.rationale: Designed to replace, not complement, Obsidian Sync; uses the user's own free private GitHub repo as storage with no server involved.

nodes.label: GitHub OAuth Device Flow
nodes.rationale: No server or callback URL needed; client_id baked into plugin code once.

nodes.label: isomorphic-git (pure JS git engine)
nodes.rationale: Pure JS, no native binaries, so sync works on iOS/Android and all desktop platforms.

nodes.label: Obsidian requestUrl API
nodes.rationale: Bypasses CORS and works on mobile without special permissions; never use fetch or axios.

nodes.label: Private GitHub repo storage
nodes.rationale: Storage choice: user's own free private GitHub repo - zero cost, private, version-controlled, no intermediate server.

nodes.label: git-sync.ts (init/clone/pull/push)
nodes.rationale: Always pull before push, enforced in git-sync.ts::sync() to avoid conflicts.

nodes.label: Debounced sync queue (mutex)
nodes.rationale: Debounced queue with mutex prevents race conditions; pushes after ~3s inactivity, flushes on close.

nodes.label: CLIENT_ID build-time injection
nodes.rationale: Precedence: shell env CLIENT_ID -> .env -> src/constants.ts fallback, resolved by esbuild at build time; .env is git-ignored.

nodes.label: GitHub repo OAuth scope
nodes.rationale: repo scope is the minimum required to create and push to private repositories.
